series: What if the countries were swapped?
title: What if Ronaldo was German?
checked: Ronaldo's Portugal debut 2003 aged 18; record men's international scorer and most capped; Portugal won Euro 2016 and the Nations League 2019 and 2025 (Ronaldo + Portugal Wikipedia pages + UEFA Nations League history). Germany since 2003: World Cup 2014, Confederations Cup 2017 (1-0 v Chile), Euro 2008 runners-up, group exits at the 2018 and 2022 World Cups (Germany Wikipedia + Confed finals list). 2026: Germany out in the last 32 on penalties to Paraguay; Portugal out to Spain in the last 16 (Sortiraparis + Portugal Wikipedia). Exact cap/goal totals left out (only one source). Alternate world clearly imagined.

lines.text: What if Cristiano Ronaldo had been born in Germany? Here's the twist nobody expects.
Real world first. Ronaldo made his Portugal debut in twenty oh-three, aged eighteen.
Since then he's become the top scorer in men's international football. Ever.
And the trophies? Euro twenty sixteen, then the Nations League in twenty nineteen and twenty twenty-five.
Now look at Germany in exactly the same years.
The World Cup in twenty fourteen, beating Argentina in the final.
And the Confederations Cup in twenty seventeen. That's two.
So the twist: Portugal won more than Germany while Ronaldo was playing.
Now, in this alternate world, Ronaldo joins that twenty fourteen German team.
In this imagined world he finally gets the one thing missing: a World Cup.
But he might lose Euro twenty sixteen, the night Portugal became champions of Europe.

scene.heading: THE TRADE-OFF
scene.body: Germany: a World Cup, but two group-stage exits since. Portugal: a Euro and two Nations Leagues.

lines.text: So which Ronaldo wins more? German Ronaldo or the real one? Tell me in the comments.
